items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And had Maurice Duran was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah. Around by 1920. That's right. And we was playing at the dreamland, right next to the Larry Theater. The fellow of the band was from Kansas City. He was a great pianist, but in black keys. His name was Udell Wilson from Kansas City. The tall fellow. He was great. And had Maurice Duran was playing trumpet. And we had Black Benny playing drum. I had Willie San Diego playing banjo. Dreamland. So, it happened. I was playing. And who comes to town but Wade.
